basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Oregon majoring in English Literature. My interests include exploring classic literature, particularly works by Thomas Pynchon, and I'm an avid fan of the Pikmin Bloom game. I often engage in discussions about ancient civilizations, with a current focus on Sumerian history. In my free time, I enjoy coming up with quirky ideas and sharing them online. I'm usually active during late afternoons and evenings, especially after classes and work. Currently single, I balance my studies with a part-time job at a local bookstore, which fuels my love for all things literary.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in English literature through academic study, which has also inspired my interest in ancient histories. My fascination with Thomas Pynchon's works stems from both coursework and personal exploration. Additionally, my participation in gaming communities, particularly around Pikmin Bloom, has been largely self-taught, with a focus on strategy and community events.
